product_metadata.title: Household Essentials 5624-1 Collapsible Single Laundry Hamper with Magnetic Lid | Chevron
features: FREE STANDING CLOTHES HAMPER with lid, handles, moisture resistant lining, and laundry bag: HOLDS approx. 2 loads of laundry
ATTACHED MAGNETIC LID keeps lid closed to cover dirty laundry
NO TOOLS ASSEMBLY: folds open to use and collapses flat to store
REMOVABLE MESH LAUNDRY BAG with handles to carry laundry to laundry room
description: HOUSEHOLD ESSENTIALS Collapsible Laundry Hamper with Lid is a hard-sided hamper that folds down nearly flat. The sleek and streamlined hamper includes a removable mesh liner and holds up to 2 loads of laundry. It has a 2.5 mm fiber board covered in polyester linen. Magnets in the lid hold the close closed to cover dirty laundry. 2 grommet handles to carry hamper, or use the removable mesh bag to carry clothes to the laundry room. Odor and moisture-resistant liner wipes clean with a damp cloth. Attractive and highly functional, this excellent hamper is perfect for bedrooms, dorm rooms and families. The hamper is 14 x 14 and 26 inches high. Unfolds to open; collapses flat to store.
